GROUP: scalar_lowering.rs, shared.rs, unit.rs, unit_arguments.rs (record 070): | 90. unit_arguments.rs:1849-1855, 744-753, 1532-1535, 5191-5207: empty capture slots dropped; `CheckedPartition` actions dropped by `filter_map` (reader: guarded by construction at unit.rs:3703-3716, not confirmed for all producers); an owner with an invalid symbol silently adopted.

GROUP: unit_composed_control.rs (record 071): | 91. 365, 3231-3236: when every path crashes, or the completion is a crash, the window-closure check is skipped. 2265, 2378, 4359-4361, 5765-5767, 5972: crash-like exits get no storage disposal from any insertion pass. 1528, 1553: a borrowed target parameter fed by another source shape gets no owner. 3564-3571: no checked transition binding means no dispatch copies and no error; reader: an arm whose binding row is missing would read live storage instead of a saved copy (checked: matches). 4838-4861, 5018-5023: `Foreign` and `Other` arrivals are accepted in unseeded groups. 4226-4235: a `DiscardRoot` disposition is synthesized when no checked roster exists. 7691-7699, 8217-8222: a missing return value is appended; only scalar `Return` registers an occurrence. 9333-9432: a loan from an unlisted source shape with no incoming resources is accepted with no retained home. 11325-11425: an entry borrowed alias is not checked for intermediate writes. 9498, 11593: shared-to-mutable promotion is keyed on supplier access and type only. 11920: a cycle closed through a `StructuralCase` edge gets no rank edge. 12261: `unwrap_or_default()` on the declared case text. 12302-12319: atomic and non-scalar fields get no snapshot. 12629-12700: in three `continue` cases the deferred `ReleaseReference` is never emitted anywhere; reader: a program with an observed reference whose retirement point cannot be found would compile with no retirement. 13428, 13445-13475: fallback loan sources. (Counted as one entry here; 16 sites.)

GROUP: unit_operation_frame.rs, unit_structural_values.rs, stages 07 and 08 (record 072): | 92. unit_operation_frame.rs:2889, 2971-2979, 2996-2998, 3011-3017: a live value that crossed a suspension but has no located home is dropped from the frontier (consumer not traced). unit_operation_frame.rs:3178-3228: a call-ensured membership is not recorded on five conditions. unit_operation_frame.rs:8085-8091: cleanup skipped when already released. unit_structural_values.rs:3593-3634: the last dispatch arm is taken without testing its pattern; reader: a program whose final arm is not exhaustive would run that arm for non-matching subjects, resting on a checker guarantee not traced (checked: matches). unit_structural_values.rs:5442-5444: owners with an invalid symbol are always live (checked: matches). unit_structural_values.rs:2268-2293: an invalid handle means no content transformation ("inferred benign, open").

GROUP: unit_operation_frame.rs, unit_structural_values.rs, stages 07 and 08 (record 072): | 93. 07/psi_optimization.rs:48-62: four selections do nothing and are still recorded as executed (checked: matches). 07/control_flow_and_retention.rs:710, 959: debug sites of unlisted kinds are kept (debug data only). 08/result_policy_verification.rs:334-336: a float boundary call whose source site is not an `Expression` is skipped without adapter verification, and the expected count excludes those sites too, so a missing adapter there would not be caught; whether such a site can carry a policy was not traced (checked: matches).
